summary: Iteration 28 — Batch B1 (shell foundation) + B2 (Registry-as-default-landing) fidelity verification. Walked the full anon + signed-in flow via Playwright against the preview URL. 12/12 review items PASS. 90 individual assertions executed: 86 initial PASS, 4 initial 'FAIL' all re-verified as test-script artifacts (see notes below), not app defects. Backend health held at parity 36/36; sign-in and fresh registration both round-trip cleanly and land on /registry with the new AkkiV4Shell chrome. Registry V4 hero, tabs, stat strip, composition grid, item-by-item table, hatched-condition chip, run-census button, sample badges — all rendered per prototype. Sidebar nav routes all 6 modules without white screens; anon visits to auth-scoped modules render honest 'NOT AUTHORISED · auth_missing / Please sign in' inside the shell (not white). Retired-vocab gate clean on /, /registry, /connect, /govern, /prove, /team, /auth/login, /auth/register. Role literal 'ask_console_user' never leaks; fresh-registered viewer renders as 'VIEWER'.
critical_code_review_comments: AkkiV4Header uses attribute name `data-testid-state` (kebab-case attribute) rather than a compound single attribute — works fine and query-selectable, but note the existing gate tests read it via getAttribute('data-testid-state'). Consistent across anon/checking/signed-in states.

RegistryV4Page fetches /api/registry/what_you_hold and /api/registry/opportunity_briefs on mount even for anon visitors; anon 401 response is swallowed silently and SAMPLE fixture is shown — Owner-compliant fallback, but produces console-noise 401s on anon /registry load (16 in one visit). Consider gating the fetch on identity !== false to reduce network noise and observability signal-to-noise.
AkkiV4Shell's Ask Akki CTA correctly disabled with title tooltip explaining B7; wordmark links to /registry (correct — Registry is the default landing per B2).

context_for_next_testing_agent: B1+B2 verified end-to-end and Owner-ready for review at the preview. Chrome (216px sidebar + 66px rich header) + Registry-as-landing all match prototype. Auth-strip anon/signed-in states + sidebar role tile + Sign out from both loci all work. Backend readyz 36/36 held constant. Owner hold: HOLD before B3–B10 proceed. When B3 lands, next agent should re-run the retired-vocab gate on any new pages, plus verify the AkkiV4Shell chrome remains the single outer shell (NestedInAkkiV4ShellContext suppression of legacy AkkiShell continues to work).

test_artifacts_investigated.NAV.connect|use-data|govern_not_blank_in: Test asserted innerText length >500 chars for anon module visits. These three modules honestly render 'NOT AUTHORISED · auth_missing / Please sign in to continue.' inside the AkkiV4Shell chrome (227/273/305 chars). Header and sidebar visible; NOT a white screen. Signed in as admin, same routes render 4596/8284/8775 chars of module content. Threshold >500 was too strict for anon; the behavior is correct role-gating within the shell.
